data.name: Bishwajit
data.gender_notes: Bishwajit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bishwajit is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bishwa' meaning universe and 'Jit' meaning conqueror. The name signifies the one who conquers the universe. The name Bishwajit carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bishwajit usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the triumph of the divine self over the material world.
data.etymology: Bishwajit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bishwajit total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bishwajit has historical and cultural significance in Hindu mythology. It is believed that Bishwajit was a name of Lord Shiva, one of the three main gods in Hinduism. He is known as the god of destruction and transformation. The name signifies the power and might of the Hindu gods and the aspiration of individuals toreach the divine level.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, the name Bishwajit can be considered as a reminder for individuals to strive towards conquering their own inner universe. The name represents the deep spiritual belief that every individual has the potential to overcome their limitations and tap into the infinite power within. It is a call to be courageous, fearless, and determined in one's spiritual journey towards enlightenment and self-realization.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bishwajit: One who is victorious over the universe. His soul has conquered all elements and is free from worldly desires. The name Bishwajit signifies the one who has transcended the boundaries of the universe. It represents the individual who has conquered all worldly desires and attained spiritual liberation. The soul of Bishwajit is free from earthly bondages, enabling him to experience the infinite bliss of the cosmos.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bishwajit was a king in the 13th century in Bengal. The name Bishwajit carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Bishwajit remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
